purpose: Rich stationary ground-only woodland base beneath separately rendered path and raised props.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: stationary ground-only base layer for a scrolling paper-cut woodland website.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the exact visual style reference.
Primary request: retain this rich mature woodland floor, but remove the entire winding footpath, the blue creek, its large stepping stones, all large rocks, all large moss bush clumps, and all tall leafy plants or large flower clumps. Inpaint those removed areas with the same richly mottled mossy paper woodland ground and fine scattered ground details. The deliverable is ONLY the continuous forest-floor base, with small low ground-level details integrated across its whole surface.
Must preserve: the original earthy olive and sage hues; abundant fine grass tufts, tiny scattered clover, tiny daisies and small low blossoms, fallen ochre/brown leaf litter, occasional acorns and small pebbles; strongly visible fibrous paper grain and hand-torn collage texture across the entire floor. Preserve the same irregular organic perimeter and the pale open clearings, with irregular mottled organic transitions into darker moss. Carry these fine details all the way from the top to bottom, including the newly filled central areas.
Composition: same full tall 1:3 canvas, conceptual dimensions 724 by 2172. Keep the ground island essentially filling the canvas with narrow genuine transparent margins around the organic edges. The ground surface is continuous and opaque inside the island; no interior cutout holes. No blank undetailed central strip where the path was.
Style and material: exactly this handmade mature paper woodland illustration, textured painted paper and layered tiny cut-paper blades/leaves. A tactile dense, richly varied floor that remains visibly detailed at mobile size. Fine floor details should be small, roughly 5–18 pixels across at a 724px width, scattered naturally. Pale clearings still have gentle grain, little grasses and scattered leaf litter, not blank solid color.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha outside the ground island. Remove all paths, roads, creeks, water, bridges and stepping stones. NO trees, people, animals, structures, stations, large rocks, raised bushes, large plants or giant flowers. No smooth vector waves, no plain green rectangle, no broad flat uniform color, no text. The larger scenery and path will be separate animated layers placed above this base.
